semantics.actor: Whether this command accepts --as in argv; required can also be supplied by actor_environment. Optional does not mean that the operation needs no identity.
semantics.accepts_person: Whether the --as value parser accepts person/NAME. This is not a grant of person authority; runtime and daemon checks still apply.
semantics.can_carry_person: Whether this command can carry a person actor, through an actor option or a configured-person fallback. It is a capability, not a grant: ST_AGENT identity guards and daemon authorization still apply.
semantics.as_role: The --as spelling is also used for a document name and for ignored read compatibility flags; these do not carry an actor.
semantics.identity_resolution: configured_actor resolves explicit actor, then ST_AGENT when it starts with agent/, then configured person. configured_human resolves explicit or configured person. Command-specific defaults and guards remain unchanged.
semantics.scope: Canonical clap command paths, including hidden commands and callable parents; aliases resolve to their canonical path.
